# HudStatus

Shows status changes with both text and color.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="hud-status" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'neutral' | 'success' | Status meaning |

### Slots

- default: status text

## Keyboard and usage notes

Uses role=status to announce changes politely; always provide text instead of relying on color.

import 'augma/style.css'
